title: How to continue a GitHub Copilot app session in VS Code
author: Kayla Cinnamon
description: Learn how to move an agent session from the GitHub Copilot app into VS Code without losing the conversation, code changes, or working context. The post How to continue a GitHub Copilot app session in VS Code appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: The agent has finished the bulk of your change. Now you want to inspect one implementation detail, adjust a few lines by hand, and run the project locally before you ship it.
takeaways: But the work is sitting in the GitHub Copilot app … and your editor is where you review diffs, debug code, and make final adjustments.
That means Copilot can handle the repetitive or time-consuming work, then hand control back to you for closer review, hands-on editing, and local testing.
If something is unclear, continue prompting Copilot in the sidebar.
